race.title: Oddschecker Bet Builder Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: PORT STATION can become another winning stable debutant for the impressive James Owen team. Novelista shades Gone Country for the next-best vote, with Wings Of Ayrton the pick of the remainder. PORT STATION (IRE) NOVELISTA (IRE) GONE COUNTRY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Gone Country (3/1), Port Station (4/1), Novelista (5/1), Kalif D'airy (11/2), Joining Force (6/1), Wings Of Ayrton (8/1), Cluain Chormaic (12/1), Amatchmadeinheaven (16/1)
